title: Account Credit Deposit Bands for Domain Care Credits on Grace-Period Renewal Charges — Domain Registrations
content:
## Deposit bands

**Clause.** For a grace-period renewal charge of Domain Registrations billed from 1 January 2022 through 30 November 2025 and paid by card or PayPal, the grace line's volume credit, one of the charge's Domain Care credits, is USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered where the account credit deposits posted on the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts account less than 12 whole months before the day of the price match total USD 5000.00 or more, USD 0.25 for each year the charge covered where they total at least USD 250.00 but less than USD 5000.00, and nothing where they total less, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

The window is counted back from the day of the price match, not from the date of the charge.

| Account credit deposits in the window | Credit for each year the charge covered |
|---|---|
| USD 5000.00 or more | USD 0.50 |
| at least USD 250.00, under USD 5000.00 | USD 0.25 |
| under USD 250.00 | nothing |

### Boundaries (hypothetical)

- Totals of USD 5000.00 and USD 4999.99 fall in different bands: USD 0.50 and USD 0.25.
- Totals of USD 250.00 and USD 249.99 fall in different bands: USD 0.25 and nothing.
- A deposit posted on 22 September 2027 counts for a price match on 21 September 2028 (11 whole months) and no longer counts on 22 September 2028 (12 whole months).
- A charge covering 2 years with deposits of USD 6200.00 in the window: USD 0.50 for each year, USD 1.00 in all.
